decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of counter spells, removal, and card advantage to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Force of Will, along with disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and grind out a victory. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds an additional layer of flexibility and resilience to the deck's game plan, allowing for additional recursion and value throughout the game.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal while utilizing card advantage and graveyard manipulation to gain an advantage. The deck includes powerful Vintage staples like Ancestral Recall, Black Lotus, and Force of Will, along with efficient removal in Fatal Push and Wasteland to control the board. Lurrus of the Dream-Den serves as a powerful companion to provide additional recursion for small creatures and artifacts, allowing the deck to outvalue opponents in long-game scenarios. Overall, the deck aims to control the game's pace and grind out a win through resource management and disruption.

The deck focuses on using Coveted Jewel as a key combo piece to generate card advantage and mana acceleration, allowing the player to utilize powerful artifacts and spells such as Mishra's Workshop, Mana Crypt, and Paradoxical Outcome to gain a significant advantage over their opponent. By leveraging efficient mana sources and card draw, the deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with its high-impact spells and artifacts.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal, and disruptive creatures while utilizing the graveyard as a resource. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, generate card advantage, and maintain control of the board until it can win through a combination of small creatures and efficient spells. It also utilizes Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a Companion for additional value and recursion. The deck has a strong mana base to support its powerful spells and can adapt to different situations with its versatile selection of cards.

The primary focus of this deck is to assemble the combo of Coveted Jewel and Paradoxical Outcome to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage. The deck includes various mana acceleration cards such as Mishra's Workshop, Sol Ring, and the Moxen to quickly ramp into the combo pieces. It also runs disruption in the form of Force of Will and Sink into Stupor to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Tinker, Time Vault, and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional win conditions and utility.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage and tempo through powerful spells like Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Psychic Frog. The deck also includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Black Lotus to provide additional resources and put the opponent on the back foot. With a mix of disruption, card advantage, and efficient threats, this deck aims to control the game from start to finish, dictating the pace and ensuring victory through careful decision-making and resource management.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and card draw to limit the opponent's options and maintain card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan through countermagic like Force of Will, Spell Pierce, and mental Misstep, while also gaining card advantage through spells like Ancestral Recall, Demonic Tutor, and Ponder. Additionally, the deck utilizes disruptive lands like Wasteland and Strip Mine to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for recurring low-cost permanents to generate card advantage and further disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on using Paradoxical Outcome to generate card advantage and mana acceleration, allowing for explosive combo plays. It aims to assemble a powerful board state quickly, utilizing various artifacts and powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to draw cards and take additional turns. The presence of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value over the course of the game. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and resilient, capable of winning games in a short amount of time through its explosive combos and efficient plays.

This deck aims to control the game through disruption and card advantage, utilizing powerful cards and efficient removal spells. The main strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gaining incremental value through card draw and recursion. By efficiently dealing with threats and disrupting the opponent's plays, this deck aims to gain control of the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional recursion and value to further solidify the control aspect of the deck.

The deck focuses on a powerful combo involving Landless Spy, utilizing cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to quickly mill through the deck and put Thassa's Oracle on top to win the game instantly. The deck also includes disruption cards like Sink into Stupor and Force of Will to protect the combo. Key cards such as Black Lotus and Dark Ritual help to quickly ramp up mana for explosive plays, while additional control elements like Chancellor of the Annex and Pact of Negation help to prevent the opponent from disrupting the combo.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures while drawing cards and gaining card advantage to control the game. It aims to outvalue the opponent and efficiently deal with threats, using cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Lórien Revealed to stay ahead. The deck also utilizes powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen to accelerate its game plan and play threats like Orcish Bowmasters and Psychic Frog. With Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck can recur valuable cards and maintain a strong board presence.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and disrupting their game plan with disruptive artifacts. By using mana acceleration from Mishra's Workshop and various Mox cards, the deck can deploy threats like Glaring Fleshraker and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim early on. The inclusion of cards like Sphere of Resistance and Null Rod slows down the opponent's plays, while cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent while preventing them from effectively responding to the threats.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on card advantage and disruption to control the game, using powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, and Dimir's new companion, Lurrus of the Dream-Den. By utilizing powerful control spells alongside mana denial effects like Wasteland and Strip Mine, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating incremental advantage through efficient card draw and removal. With a mix of powerful control spells and disruptive threats like Psychic Frog and Undercity Sewers, this deck aims to control the game and out-value the opponent.

This deck aims to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan by playing powerful artifacts like Chalice of the Void, Trinisphere, and Null Rod. It also utilizes aggressive creatures like Magus of the Moon and Pyrogoyf to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also has some card advantage tools like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Vexing Bauble to maintain its tempo. With the help of powerful mana acceleration cards like Black Lotus, Sol Ring, and Mana Crypt, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory in a fast-paced game.

The main concept of this Vintage Aggro-Hatebear deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategies by using hate cards like Archon of Emeria, Chancellor of the Annex, and Void Mirror while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Clarion Conqueror and White Plume Adventurer. The deck also utilizes powerful mana acceleration from cards like Ancient Tomb and Moxen to quickly deploy threats. The inclusion of disruptive elements like Wasteland and Karakas aims to slow down the opponent's game plan, allowing this deck to gain an advantage and close out the game quickly.

This deck aims to disrupt opponents by using artifacts such as Chalice of the Void, Null Rod, and Stony Silence to hinder their strategy. It also relies on cards like Void Mirror and Phyrexian Revoker to control the board and prevent opponents from playing their spells effectively. The deck can quickly ramp up with powerful mana sources like Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb to bring out threats like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Nettlecyst. Overall, the strategy focuses on aggression and disruption to overwhelm opponents and secure a victory.
